title: Choose the visual world
question: Seven worlds for The Living Atelier's redesign. Lock one, adopt a demoted challenger, take the standard, or steer a fresh hand.

options.label: The Rack Elevation
options.thesis: Infrastructure presented as it actually ships: racked, labeled, live.
options.viewport: A full-height front elevation: Haris nameplate as the top unit, chapters racked below, status LEDs running.
options.risk: Cold and impersonal if the labeling isn't editorially rigorous; theme-park techy if it is decorative instead of true.
options.case: Assigned by the roll. Engineers read rack elevations natively; credibility comes free, warmth must be earned by typography.

raised.raise: One unbroken functional spine: a live status-bus strip runs the whole page, state written into it as you move.
Total text-chrome discipline: every element drawn from one stencil-label grammar; new content announces itself as a system message.
One governing force: scroll drives a single coherent power/data flow through the elevation.
Packaged-object model: each project is a sealed unit whose face pulls out on rails to the full case study.
Theatrical type contrast: RU numerals enormous against silkscreen-small labels; scale carries emotion, not ornament.

options.label: Split-Flap Departures
options.thesis: Every work a scheduled departure on a board that flips as you arrive.
options.viewport: A giant board caught mid-flip spelling HARIS / CLOUD ENGINEER; works listed as departures with gates and statuses.
options.risk: Also where most engineer portfolios would love to land; flap mechanics can outrun the content they announce.
options.case: My top-ranked candidate before the roll: strongest kinetic memory, native systems metaphor.

options.label: Azulejo Station Hall
options.thesis: Infra narratives painted cobalt across a strict tile grid; blank tiles hold places for real work.
options.viewport: Panels cross whole-tile seams; the active scene deepens in cobalt while neighbors fade toward glaze white.
options.risk: Reads heritage-decorative unless the grid discipline is absolute.
options.case: Engineering-as-art is literally its thesis; blank tiles make placeholder honesty beautiful. Loses narrowly on audience nativeness.

options.label: Massin Stage Page
options.thesis: System components speak as staged voices; size is volume, collision is argument.
options.viewport: An uptime incident typeset as theater across the spread; captions stay calm at the margins.
options.risk: Designer-flavored more than engineer-native; drifts from infrastructure truth.
options.case: Proves craft-itself supremely; recruiters identify less readily than engineers do.

options.label: Step-Sequencer Row
options.thesis: The portfolio as sixteen candy steps under a running chase light.
options.viewport: One unbroken step row as the page spine; tempo readout above.
options.risk: Says music tool, not infrastructure; the metaphor strains by chapter two.
options.kept: The single functional spine you write state into.

options.label: ANSI BBS Nightboard
options.thesis: Haris's board at 2 a.m.: block-glyph chrome, numbered exits, scarce presence.
options.viewport: Title art pours in line by line over an 80-by-25 cell grid.
options.risk: It is the excluded terminal-gimmick rut, wearing nostalgia; near-black-plus-glow is an AI calibration cluster.
options.kept: Total text-chrome discipline; events announced as system messages.

options.label: Gravity Rain Garden
options.thesis: Clouds color-coded by law; rain falls differently around each system.
options.viewport: Four rains falling in different directions around planted artifacts.
options.risk: Pure cleverness; says nothing true about cloud engineering.
options.kept: One governing force animating everything consistently.

options.label: Window-Box Aisle
options.thesis: Each project a lidded box; light through cellophane windows.
options.viewport: Shelf rows of boxed sets, one end-cap hero lit.
options.risk: Tonally wrong for a cloud engineer; regresses into the cream-ground AI cluster.
options.kept: The packaged-object model: sealed face opens to the full story.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
